status: LIVE EXACT — one pinned App Server spawn lifecycle was correlated with same-connection thread/read bytes and projected into a Workflow execution receipt

derivedClaims.freshContext: true only when one item/started and item/completed spawnAgent lifecycle names the readback receiver, the same session and parent are retained, forkedFromId is null, the whole-second thread creation interval overlaps the millisecond spawn lifecycle, and the readback first turn agrees with its lifecycle notifications
derivedClaims.finalMessage: the last raw phase=final_answer item by completedAtMs inside the completed readback turn, byte-matched to the normalized readback final item; raw and readback item ids are retained separately
derivedClaims.threadStarted: a child thread/started notification is optional because Codex 0.139.0 did not emit one for the spawned child in this run; if present, it must agree with readback

boundary.collectorMeaning: the shipped collector consumes supplied notifications and readbacks and contains no App Server connection or driving verb
boundary.liveHarnessMeaning: a separate bounded evidence harness attached once, started one parent turn, requested exactly one fresh child, read both threads on the same connection, then terminated its launched process tree
boundary.coverage: absence of a notification is not evidence the action did not occur

relatedLiveObservation.result: earlier Codex Desktop records emitted App-visible sub_agent_activity and completed real subagent rollouts
relatedLiveObservation.reason: the earlier Desktop rollout records remain a separate evidence class; S057 is satisfied by the later direct pinned App Server run, not by converting those records

identifierRedaction: Raw Codex thread, session and turn identifiers are withheld from the repository: they are UUIDv7 and therefore carry both a creation timestamp and a reference to a real session on the operator's machine, which the privacy gate refuses (THREAD_IDENTIFIER). Each occurrence is replaced by redacted-<first 24 hex of sha256(raw id)>, so the same session remains the same token throughout and a verifier holding the raw live artifacts can recompute the digest and re-establish the linkage. No claim in this receipt depends on the raw identifier.
